name: sciwrite-publish
description: Navigate publication: choosing a journal, the submission process, responding to reviewers after a revise-and-resubmit, performing a peer review yourself, authorship decisions and order, plagiarism and self-plagiarism, and spotting predatory journals. Based on Stanford's Writing in the Sciences. Use this skill whenever someone mentions submitting a paper, a decision letter, reviewer comments, a rebuttal or response letter, "revise and resubmit", "my paper was rejected", being invited to review a manuscript, who should be an author or in what order, whether a passage counts as plagiarism, reusing their own text from a previous paper, an unsolicited invitation from a journal or conference, or whether a journal is legitimate. Also use it when someone asks how to choose where to submit. Do NOT use it for writing the manuscript itself (sciwrite-manuscript) or for grant applications or responding to grant or fellowship reviewers (sciwrite-proposals).
